# Tenant API reference

Routes under `/api/tenant`, for scripts that run a tenant's console. Authenticate with a developer key: `Authorization: Bearer tdk_…`; each route needs the capability shown. Choose test or live data with `?livemode=true|false` (default `false`). A platform key with *Act for tenants* can call every route for a tenant with `PayLink-Tenant: {slug}`. Guide: [automation API](../automation/tenant-api.md).

OpenAPI document: [tenant.json](pathname:///openapi/tenant.json). Every PayLink also serves it at `/docs/api/tenant/openapi.json`, with Swagger UI at `/docs/api`.

## /overview

### `GET /api/tenant/overview`

What the console's overview shows: the last 7 days, what is waiting, and how far set-up has got.

Needs a developer key with the **payments.read** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `livemode` | query | boolean |   |

## /payments

### `POST /api/tenant/payments`

Creates a payment (as "New payment" in the console does) and returns its checkout_url to share. Amounts in paise.

Needs a developer key with the **payments.write** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `livemode` | query | boolean |   |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `amount` | integer int64 |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `reference` | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `return_url` | string |  |
| `customer_name` | string |  |
| `customer_email` | string |  |
| `customer_phone` | string |  |
| `customer_id` | string |  |
| `metadata` | map of string |  |
| `expires_in_seconds` | integer int32 |  |

### `GET /api/tenant/payments`

Payments, newest first, with the console's filters. Dates are UTC days (yyyy-MM-dd); amounts in paise. Answers total and total_amount for the filter.

Needs a developer key with the **payments.read** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `livemode` | query | boolean |   |
| `status` | query | string |   |
| `q` | query | string |   |
| `method` | query | string |   |
| `from` | query | string |   |
| `to` | query | string |   |
| `min_amount` | query | integer int64 |   |
| `max_amount` | query | integer int64 |   |
| `reference` | query | string |   |
| `limit` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `offset` | query | integer int32 |   |

### `POST /api/tenant/payments/{id}/release`

Releases a payment a risk rule put on hold, so the payer can pay.

Needs a developer key with the **payments.write** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `note` | string |  |

### `GET /api/tenant/payments/export`

The payments list as CSV (up to 50,000 rows), with the same filters as GET /payments.

Needs a developer key with the **payments.read** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `livemode` | query | boolean |   |
| `status` | query | string |   |
| `q` | query | string |   |
| `method` | query | string |   |
| `from` | query | string |   |
| `to` | query | string |   |
| `min_amount` | query | integer int64 |   |
| `max_amount` | query | integer int64 |   |
| `reference` | query | string |   |

### `GET /api/tenant/payments/{id}/attempts/{attemptId}/proof`

The payer's UPI screenshot for an attempt. Every view is audited.

Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |
| `attemptId` | path | string | required  |

### `GET /api/tenant/payments/{id}`

A payment with its attempts, refunds and full journey (every event, with who did it).

Needs a developer key with the **payments.read** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

### `POST /api/tenant/payments/{id}/cancel`

Cancels an open payment.

Needs a developer key with the **payments.write** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |

| `note` | string |  |

### `POST /api/tenant/payments/{id}/refunds`

A refund through the gateway, or (manual = true, reason required) a refund the merchant made outside PayLink.

Needs a developer key with the **refunds** capability.

|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

Body (JSON):

## /reports

### `GET /api/tenant/reports`

## /settlements

### `POST /api/tenant/settlements`

Imports a gateway's settlement report (CSV, multipart field "report" or a text/csv body). Without a mapping PayLink uses the
columns it recognises (the same guess the console shows); pass column numbers (0-based) to override.

Needs a developer key with the **reconciliation** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connector` | query | string |   |
| `reference` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `gross` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `fee` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `tax` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `net` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `date` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `settlement_ref` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `paise` | query | boolean |   |

### `GET /api/tenant/settlements`

Imported reports, lines that need a look, the daily close and paid gateway payments not yet settled.

Needs a developer key with the **reconciliation** capability.

## /team

### `GET /api/tenant/team`

Who may sign in, the members with their roles, and the role map.

Needs a developer key with the **team** capability.

### `PUT /api/tenant/team/admission`

Who may sign in to the console: approve_only, auto_tenant_admins, role or anyone.

Needs a developer key with the **team** capability.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string |  |

### `POST /api/tenant/team/members/{id}`

Approves a person with a role, changes their role, or removes them. Keys can't make owners or remove the last owner;
owners are made by an owner in the console.

Needs a developer key with the **team** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer int64 | required  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `decision` | string |  |
| `role` | string |  |

### `PUT /api/tenant/team/role-map`

Maps a LoginLink role to a PayLink role (used by the "role" admission mode). An empty paylink_role removes the mapping.

Needs a developer key with the **team** capability.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `loginlink_role` | string |  |
| `paylink_role` | string |  |

## /domain

### `GET /api/tenant/domain`

The tenant's own domain, its DNS records and verification state.

Needs a developer key with the **domain** capability.

### `PUT /api/tenant/domain`

Adds a domain. Add the TXT record returned, point the domain at PayLink, then verify.

Needs a developer key with the **domain** capability.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `domain` | string |  |

### `DELETE /api/tenant/domain`

Removes the domain; the platform's address is used again.

Needs a developer key with the **domain** capability.

### `POST /api/tenant/domain/verify`

Checks the TXT record. Answers 422 while it isn't found.

Needs a developer key with the **domain** capability.

## /data-access

### `GET /api/tenant/data-access`

The CrudApi connection, the platform's CrudApi address, and the reporting API path.

Needs a developer key with the **data_access** capability.

### `DELETE /api/tenant/data-access`

Unregisters the database from CrudApi and removes the read-only user PayLink made.

Needs a developer key with the **data_access** capability.

### `PUT /api/tenant/data-access/reader`

Step 1: a read-only database user (PayLink creates one when it can; otherwise send yours, which is checked to be SELECT-only).

Needs a developer key with the **data_access** capability.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | string |  |
| `password` | string |  |
| `host` | string |  |

### `POST /api/tenant/data-access/register`

Step 2: registers the database in a CrudApi workspace and creates a Reader client. Its secret is returned once.

Needs a developer key with the **data_access** capability.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | string |  |
| `workspace` | string |  |
| `key` | string |  |

## /keys

### `GET /api/tenant/keys`

The tenant's keys (secrets never returned).

Needs a developer key with the **keys** capability.

### `POST /api/tenant/keys`

Creates a secret key (kind "secret", for /api/v1) or a developer key (kind "developer", for /api/tenant). A developer key
can only be given capabilities the calling key has. The key is returned once.

Needs a developer key with the **keys** capability.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |
| `kind` | string |  |
| `livemode` | boolean |  |
| `capabilities` | array of string |  |
| `expires_at` | string |  |

### `DELETE /api/tenant/keys/{id}`

Revokes a key. Calls with it answer 401 from then on.

Needs a developer key with the **keys** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer int64 | required  |

## /requests

### `GET /api/tenant/requests`

The API request log: the last calls made with this tenant's keys (no bodies).

Needs a developer key with the **keys** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | integer int32 |   |

## /audit

### `GET /api/tenant/audit`

The tenant's audit log, newest first. verify=true also checks the hash chain.

Needs a developer key with the **audit** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `verify` | query | boolean |   |

## /upi

### `GET /api/tenant/upi/pending`

PayLink UPI payments waiting for a decision: the UTR the payer entered, and whether there's a screenshot.

Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `livemode` | query | boolean |   |

### `POST /api/tenant/upi/{attemptId}/approve`

Approves a UPI payment: the money arrived. The note is kept on the journey.

Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attemptId` | path | string | required  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `note` | string |  |

### `POST /api/tenant/upi/{attemptId}/reject`

Rejects a UPI payment: no such credit. The note is kept on the journey.

Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attemptId` | path | string | required  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `note` | string |  |

### `GET /api/tenant/upi/decided`

UPI payments already approved or rejected (newest first): who decided, when, and the note.

Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `livemode` | query | boolean |   |
| `decision` | query | string |   |
| `q` | query | string |   |
| `from` | query | string |   |
| `to` | query | string |   |
| `limit` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `offset` | query | integer int32 |   |

### `POST /api/tenant/upi/statements`

Matches a bank statement (CSV) against UPI payments waiting for a check: credits whose UTR and amount match are approved.
Send the file as multipart/form-data (field "statement") or as the raw body with Content-Type text/csv.

Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `livemode` | query | boolean |   |

Body (`text/csv` or `multipart/form-data`):

The file itself.

## /methods

### `GET /api/tenant/methods`

Every payment method with its fields and this tenant's Test and Live settings (secrets never returned).

Needs a developer key with the **methods** capability.

### `PUT /api/tenant/methods/{connectorId}/{mode}`

Saves a method's settings for test or live and, with enabled true, checks them and turns it on. A failed check answers 422.

Needs a developer key with the **methods** capability.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connectorId` | path | string | required  |
| `mode` | path | string | required  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean |  |
| `settings` | map of string |  |
